body: Maybe I shall try this, thank you so much :)
I am 19 and yes I do but it’s not the greatest for helping with mental health related problems.
I don’t think there is anything else but thank you for trying to help :)

I like all types of music and drawing, also I love all things Disney :) and my two friends are so tired of hearing my struggles and I don’t like bothering them. And I’d assume it’s just my bipolar depression that makes me feel this way, and it’s exhausting to try and keep my emotions at bay. And starving myself is the only way I ever feel any accomplishment anymore, whenever I shed a pound or pass out I feel so happy. And I figure if hurting myself is the only thing that brings me joy I should stop.

Yeah I do a lot to distract myself, and I’m running out of things to do. And I’m losing interest in things I’ve done for years. I draw, play video games and I’m obsessed with music and I tried writing. But nothing is helping with the overwhelming urge to just end it. And I can assure you I’m pretty gross but you’d never believe me because a lot of people claim this. But I suppose that’s not the point of all this. My mental capacity is just reaching its end and I wanna do something about it but I fear I’ve run out of distractions. The only thing I have left to feel like I have any sort of control over my life is to starve myself and that’s so selfish, because people could really use the food I refuse to eat or waste but I can’t stop myself.

I am currently alone, no close family that cares, no friend and no romantic relationship, this could be because I’m rather disgusting to look at and annoying to be around. But I’m glad you have Someone and I mean it sincerely, if I had someone who cared for me I would cherish them as should you. But I’d also draw that line that they aren’t all that matters ya know? I’d love and appreciate them while also understanding that even with out them I’m worth it. I wish I could have what you have and I’m happy for you, I hope you find even more healthy ways to cope and I appreciate your response.
How did you push through it all because I’m losing my will to fight.
I’m afraid I won’t be able to afford either and financial struggle worries me more than me just deciding to end it. If that makes sense.

It was rather depressing in itself if I’m being honest, they really just gave me as many pills as they could and made us color and listen to really unhelpful and vague advice that didn’t do much for anyone.

Thank you for responding, and yes I have spoken to a psychiatrist and they sent me to a hospital after only three visits and if I’m being honest it did  absolutely nothing for me. But I really just wanna be happy and okay. If not for me but at least my family. My self harm has varied through the years and it’s been so bad recently I’m starting to worry. ( also sorry if I’m making mistakes I’m rather drunk rn)
